name: Godreaper
storyline: The fate of the native land fell upon the shoulders of Zaremir — the only one the fading world can rely on. The familiar order collapsed the moment an ancient curse gnawed into the roots of the World Tree. It poisoned the very essence of existence, and those who had preserved order for centuries were the first to fall victim to madness. The Slavic gods lost their minds, and in their wake countless creatures from Nav flooded into Yav, devouring everything in their path. Draw your faithful sword "Vspokh", find other bogatyrs to revive your ancient brotherhood and challenge the afflictions tormenting the land of your ancestors. Enlist the support of the powerful Baba Yaga and the wayward Koschei to unmask those who stand behind the destruction of the world.
summary: Godreaper is a dark third-person action-adventure where the fate of your homeland hangs in the balance. As the bogatyr Zaremire, explore every corner of a world inspired by East Slavic mythology. Defeat the creatures of Navi, battle almighty gods and save your homeland from inevitable destruction.
